name: original-minimal
command:
from pathlib import Path
import os
hosts = Path('/control/netcfg-hosts').read_text() if False else '127.0.0.1 localhost\n'
Path('/etc/hosts').write_text('127.0.0.1 obs-fixture\n' + hosts)
if not False:
    for filename in ['/etc/passwd','/etc/group']:
        p = Path(filename)
        p.write_text(''.join(line for line in p.read_text().splitlines(True) if not line.startswith('nobody:')))
Path('/etc/nsswitch.conf').write_text('passwd: files\ngroup: files\nhosts: files dns\n')
import pwd
try:
    pwd.getpwnam('nobody')
    found = True
except KeyError:
    found = False
assert found == False, (found, False)
print('HOSTS:', Path('/etc/hosts').read_text(), flush=True)
print('False:', [line for line in Path('/etc/passwd').read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('nobody:')], flush=True)
os.execvp('setpriv', ['setpriv','--reuid=1019','--regid=100','--clear-groups','python3','tools/test.py','-j','2','-p','tap','--mode=release','--flaky-tests=run'] + ['parallel/test-http2-invalid-last-stream-id', 'parallel/test-http2-premature-close', 'parallel/test-net-socket-connect-without-cb', 'parallel/test-tcp-wrap-listen', 'parallel/test-process-euid-egid', 'report/test-report-exclude-network'])
